title: Trump’s latest AI czar has already resigned
slides: Trump's AI czar quit after only days — why?
The resignation came without any public explanation.
Insiders hint at a clash over China strategy.
Your AI policy outlook just became more uncertain.
Watch for the next appointment — it signals direction.
thread_text:
1. AI Czar Quit in Days

No public explanation. The Trump administration's AI policy lead resigned after only days on the job, with zero official comment released.

2. Clash Over China

Internal sources say the split was over China strategy. The now-former czar pushed a hardline tech ban; the White House hesitated.

3. Policy Outlook Darkens

Without a czar, your AI regulatory certainty just evaporated. Existing executive orders now face implementation delays and internal infighting.

4. Next Pick Is the Signal

The successor's stance on China and regulation will reveal the administration's true direction. Watch for leaked shortlists this week.

5. Your Move Today

Check your AI compliance plans: have you modeled a sudden export-control tightening? If not, run that scenario by your legal team this week.
